summary: the machine's clock IS the universe's clock. The Boerdijk-Coxeter time quasicrystal that renews the computational magic advances by theta=arccos(-2/3) = the discrete de Sitter angle -(q-1)/q, with fundamental beat 30 = h(E8) (the 600-cell's 20 rings of 30). Inflation reads off the same clock: e-folds N = 2*30 = 60 (twice the beat), and CMB tilt 1 - n_s = 2/N = 1/30 = 1/(beat) -- the spectrum's deviation from scale invariance is the inverse of the clock's period. The structures match in kind: the clock is a time quasicrystal (nearly periodic, never exact) as inflation is quasi-de Sitter (nearly exponential, never exact), both broken de Sitter by q=3 -- the clock's aperiodicity = the cosmology's tilt. Architecture time (Face 5) and cosmic expansion (Face 7) are one quasicrystal: angle -(q-1)/q, beat h(E8)=30, tilt 1/beat.
